name: Banarasi Sarees
description: Rich brocade silk woven with Mughal-inspired gold zari motifs from the holy city of Varanasi. Each piece is a masterpiece of Indian handloom heritage, taking weeks to perfect by master artisans.
shortDescription: Mughal-inspired gold zari motifs on pure silk from Varanasi.

name: Kanjeevaram Sarees
description: The queen of South Indian silks — bold temple borders and lustrous jewel-toned pure mulberry silk.
shortDescription: Bold temple borders and lustrous pure mulberry silk.

name: Pochampally Ikkat
description: Mesmerizing geometric patterns born from the ancient resist-dye weaving technique of Telangana.
shortDescription: Ancient resist-dye weaving with geometric patterns.

name: Bandhani Sarees
description: A thousand tiny knots blooming into vibrant patterns — the timeless tie-dye art of Rajasthan and Gujarat.
shortDescription: The timeless tie-dye art of Rajasthan and Gujarat.

name: Leheriya Sarees
description: Waves of colour cascading diagonally — Rajasthan's joyful resist-dye craft in soft pastel hues.
shortDescription: Rajasthan's joyful resist-dye craft in pastel hues.

name: Paithani Sarees
description: Maharashtra's crown jewel — handwoven silk adorned with dancing peacocks and oblique square borders.
shortDescription: Handwoven silk adorned with dancing peacocks.

name: Chanderi Sarees
description: Ethereal and light as air — sheer silk-cotton fabric from Madhya Pradesh with delicate golden zari borders.
shortDescription: Sheer silk-cotton fabric with delicate golden zari.

name: Maheshwari Sarees
description: A royal patronage since the Holkar dynasty — distinctive reversible borders in cotton-silk perfection.

name: Muga Silk Sarees
description: Assam's golden treasure — the only naturally golden silk in the world, glowing brighter with every wash.
shortDescription: Assam's naturally golden silk, growing brighter with age.

name: Dharmavaram Sarees
description: Andhra Pradesh's bridal favourite — rich heavy silk with dramatically contrasting pallu and wide temple borders.
shortDescription: Rich heavy silk with dramatically contrasting pallus.

name: Georgette Sarees
description: Contemporary elegance in flowing lightweight fabric — modern prints and delicate embellishments for the new-age woman.
shortDescription: Contemporary elegance in flowing lightweight fabric.

name: Chiffon Sarees
description: Ultra-lightweight, sheer, and gracefully flowing. Perfect for evening wear and elegant minimalist looks.
